claim_tested: A favorable star rating by itself proves completed ownership service.
scope: Sufficiency of the proxy, not prevalence of false ratings.
reason: Explicit prospective/no-vehicle accounts have favorable ratings. They can value discovery without completing ownership service.
does_not_establish: No claim that most positive reviews are false, incentivized, or valueless.

claim_tested: Every useful Auto2000 finance exploration requires personal contact data first.
scope: Blanket gating claim, not all financing or service tasks.
reason: A repeatable simulator and insurance sensitivity were observed with optional income and contact data empty.
does_not_establish: No loan approval, quote accuracy, participant usability, or absence of friction elsewhere.

claim_tested: The Auto2000 hybrid/ICE comparison is uniformly unusable because one field is malformed.
scope: Blanket functional-failure claim for the inspected scenario.
reason: The evaluator completed the comparison and observed price/transmission differences, alongside an airbag field displaying TRUE.
does_not_establish: No claim that all fields are correct or real buyers understand them.

claim_tested: Toyota Indonesia has no published battery-health certificate capability.
reason: Official terms describe an eligible service-linked certificate and warranty-validation boundary.
does_not_establish: No claim of universal eligibility, use, discoverability, data accuracy, or resale effect.

claim_tested: A higher digital booking share necessarily creates incremental transaction gross profit.
scope: Logical necessity under a valid channel-migration counterexample.
reason: The same completed jobs at unchanged unit economics can switch channels with zero additional transaction GP.
does_not_establish: No claim that actual Digiroom volume is mostly migration or that cost savings are zero.

claim_tested: An initial no-branch B&P result proves Auto2000 has no available branch route in other localities.
scope: Universal interpretation of an initial locality-dependent UI state.
reason: Searching Bekasi returned a named B&P branch and calendar without plate entry.
does_not_establish: No claim of real available service slots, capacity, completed booking or current service eligibility.
